name: Taira no Kanemori
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 40); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: Alas! the blush upon my cheek
poems.author: Taira no Kanemori
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 40
poems.text:
Alas! the blush upon my cheek,
Conceal it as I may,
Proclaims to all that I’m in love,
Till people smile and say—
‘Where are thy thoughts to-day?’
